owners.name: The Stillcord entrance arch
owners.description: Bound timber and hanging tokens frame the road north. The central way is physically open in this artwork; there are no painted gate leaves.

owners.name: Nemm Hushbell
owners.description: The western entrance keeper wraps the bell because its clapper startles the creek frogs. He is tired of being called the new one.

owners.name: Hesta Brack
owners.description: Captain of the Stillcord. She remembers the work of bringing people down the upper road, and sometimes mistakes concern for authority.

owners.name: The entrance flower box
owners.description: Flowers soften the waiting space between the northern houses. A planter makes a better boundary here than another spear.

owners.name: The Return Desk herb pot
owners.description: A narrow round pot by the witness cottage. Its flowers have survived several explanations of who was meant to water it.

owners.name: Doorstep sorting bowl
owners.description: A low bowl holds pale odds and ends beside the step. Its contents are not assigned a quest value or item blueprint yet.

owners.name: Vennit Rusk · The Return Desk
owners.description: A visiting Recension field scribe. His return accounts distinguish what someone saw, what someone said and what remains uncertain.

owners.name: The Dry Hem flower box
owners.description: Pell tends this box while watching the road. He claims the flowers tell him nothing about who might be coming.

owners.name: The Dry Hem lost-property crate
owners.description: The small crate is meant for things left behind. Pell distinguishes abandoned property from property whose owner is late.

owners.name: Pell Drowse · The Dry Hem
owners.description: The guesthouse keeper collects abandoned boots and insists every pair is only waiting for its owner. He watches the courtyard for wet arrivals.

owners.name: Morrowfast rain cistern
owners.description: A communal basin of dark rainwater, ringed with worn stone. Visitors can pass on both sides, even while somebody is filling a bucket.

owners.name: Communal drawing bucket
owners.description: The bucket is older than its newest hoop. A pale worn patch shows where everybody grips it.

owners.name: The Long Loop · courtyard counter
owners.description: Ochre and green cloth shade Orrit's outside counter. The vessels and cord on display are furnishings for one shop, not duplicate free stock.

owners.name: The Long Loop wash barrel
owners.description: A barrel of wash water stands beside the outside counter. The cleaner-looking cup is still a workshop cup, not a promise of drinking water.

owners.name: Orrit's cord basket
owners.description: Orrit separates useful lengths from scraps here. A piece too short for one job may be exactly long enough for another.

owners.name: The western footbridge
owners.description: Short boards cross the dark creek to the guesthouse back walk. The center is worn smooth; the hand-lashed posts are newer.

owners.name: Stream-bank glasspane frog
owners.description: A pale frog has chosen a stone beside the crossing. Nemm lowers his voice here and denies doing it.

owners.name: Orrit's loaded handcart
owners.description: Tools and bundled boards ride beside the Long Loop. The load is arranged so the things needed first are easiest to reach.

owners.name: The Long Loop spare cask
owners.description: An empty cask lies where Orrit can brace it with a foot. Its hoops have been adjusted more recently than its staves.

owners.name: The Long Loop outside worktable
owners.description: A low table for cups, tools and jobs that should dry in the open air. Orrit leaves an empty patch for whatever the next visitor brings.

owners.name: Orrit's paired rope coils
owners.description: Two carefully laid coils keep their ends where somebody can find them. They are workshop property, not an unclaimed rescue reward.

owners.name: Orrit Coilstitch · The Long Loop
owners.description: A mender who charges fairly for his time and quietly gives away fixes he thinks somebody cannot safely leave without.

owners.name: The Second Bowl · market counter
owners.description: Violet cloth shades bowls of provisions. One corner has been wiped much more often than the others.

owners.name: Sella Kettle · The Second Bowl
owners.description: The cook keeps a public table despite the cost. Every new pot is introduced as yesterday's soup.

owners.name: The Second Bowl counter cask
owners.description: A small cask sits beside the serving counter. Sella has turned its roughest stave toward the stall.

owners.name: The Second Bowl washing bucket
owners.description: A bucket waits near the counter leg. The washing water belongs here; Sella dislikes finding it beside the cistern dipper.

owners.name: The Second Bowl supply barrel
owners.description: A barrel of kitchen supplies stands outside the cookshop. The lid is set where Sella can reach it without putting down a bowl.

owners.name: The Second Bowl spare bucket
owners.description: An empty bucket waits between the supply barrel and the kitchen wall. It is small enough to disappear behind whichever job is urgent.

owners.name: The Second Bowl outside stove
owners.description: A dark pot rests on a squat stone cooking stand. The space around it has been cleared for feet, kindling and the person carrying the hot bowl.

owners.name: The Second Bowl kindling crate
owners.description: Long dry pieces stand beside the outdoor stove. The narrow crate keeps them upright and off the wet ground.

owners.name: The Second Bowl chopping block
owners.description: A low block beside the kitchen has a useful flat top. The working face is small enough that it has escaped becoming a seat.

owners.name: The Second Bowl spare cask
owners.description: A cask lies beyond the chopping block, safely outside the door swing. Nobody calls it spare when the washing starts.

owners.name: The Second Bowl covered reserve
owners.description: A broad covered barrel stands above the cookshop. Its heavy-looking lid keeps the contents a matter for Sella rather than passing wildlife.

owners.name: The low southern oven
owners.description: A turf-backed stone oven faces the arrival lane. Its sheltered mouth gives tired visitors somewhere obvious to stop and set a load down.

owners.name: Mossfoot
owners.description: A patient yellowfoot wayfarer beside the southern oven. There is room to walk around him, although Sella says he prefers the warmest route.

owners.name: Stillcord Gate House · walls
owners.description: Compact keeper house upper left. Original visible masonry shell below the removable roof remains fixed. Loose shrub below the west front and exterior shoulder rocks are excluded where separable; reconstructed floor polygon is a provisional interior footprint.

owners.name: Stillcord Gate House · roof
owners.description: Lift this independent roof to inspect the reconstructed room below.

owners.name: Stillcord Gate House · door
owners.description: Independent original wooden door leaf. Open it to expose the reconstructed threshold.

owners.name: Watch rest bench
owners.description: A narrow bench faces the spare equipment. Its longest scratches are at boot height.

owners.name: Watch supply chest
owners.description: The common chest holds equipment already paid for by watch shifts.

owners.name: Duty desk
owners.description: Weighted local return notes sit on the duty desk. None claims to explain the Felling.

owners.name: The Dry Hem · walls
owners.description: Large middle-left guesthouse. Roof includes its stone parapet caps and rooftop vent. Front flower trough, sign crate and person are independent outdoor owners, with indentation in the lower shell contour to avoid those visible props.

owners.name: The Dry Hem · roof
owners.description: Lift this independent roof to inspect the reconstructed room below.

owners.name: The Dry Hem · door
owners.description: Independent original wooden door leaf. Open it to expose the reconstructed threshold.

owners.name: Western guest bed
owners.description: A separate paid bed with a green cover, blanket and wooden frame.

owners.name: Eastern guest bed
owners.description: The second bed is its own owner; booking or moving one bed does not change the other.

owners.name: Guesthouse warming stove
owners.description: A little stove and kettle warm the common room. The flame must follow the stove active state.

owners.name: Guesthouse supper table
owners.description: A household table with ordinary dishes and a folded note; its fixed drawn settings are inspected through the table owner.

owners.name: Western supper stool
owners.description: A small stool beside the supper table.

owners.name: Eastern supper stool
owners.description: The eastern stool can be inspected or moved independently.

owners.name: Spare supper stool
owners.description: A spare stool has been set back from the table on open floor. It leaves room to walk between the table and the guest beds.

owners.name: Orrit's Long Loop · walls
owners.description: Lower-left mender home. Cut roof through bottom cap stones, not the darker front wall beneath them. South frontage tools, bench, seated/standing resident, ground rope coils and eastern work cart are separate exterior owners.

owners.name: Orrit's Long Loop · roof
owners.description: Lift this independent roof to inspect the reconstructed room below.

owners.name: Orrit's Long Loop · door
owners.description: Independent original wooden door leaf. Open it to expose the reconstructed threshold.

owners.name: Mender interior workbench
owners.description: The long bench holds tools for actual paid work; service authoring must name its consumed material and result.

owners.name: Mender storage barrel
owners.description: A bound barrel stands inside the mender's house.

owners.name: Reserve rescue cord
owners.description: A separately owned coil belongs to the common watch supply. Its use or loan needs an actual inventory outcome.

owners.name: The Return Desk · walls
owners.description: Upper-right witness cottage. Irregular arched roof with a central stone spine. Exclude flower barrel at east and the loose bowl below its southeast corner. Steps are shell/threshold; wooden door leaf has its own owner.

owners.name: The Return Desk · roof
owners.description: Lift this independent roof to inspect the reconstructed room below.

owners.name: The Return Desk · door
owners.description: Independent original wooden door leaf. Open it to expose the reconstructed threshold.

owners.name: Northern record shelf
owners.description: Bound local witness records sit in rows. Accounts are attributed and may diverge.

owners.name: Western record shelf
owners.description: A second, separately owned record shelf holds field copies.

owners.name: Witness writing desk
owners.description: Weights, ink and a copy in progress. Personal testimony requires its speaker's consent.

owners.name: Archive storage barrel
owners.description: A dry barrel for ordinary station supplies.

owners.name: The Second Bowl · walls
owners.description: Lower-right kitchen home. Roof includes chimney and cap stones but not dark front masonry. Open pot on west, barrel near northwest, ground barrels/stools on southeast and exterior shop props remain independently extractable.

owners.name: The Second Bowl · roof
owners.description: Lift this independent roof to inspect the reconstructed room below.

owners.name: The Second Bowl · door
owners.description: Independent original wooden door leaf. Open it to expose the reconstructed threshold.

owners.name: Kitchen hearth
owners.description: The hearth is an owned heat source and cooking fixture. Fire and steam must cease when it is cold or absent.

owners.name: Kitchen preparation table
owners.description: A chopping board and bowl on an ordinary narrow table; recipe outcomes are separately authored.

owners.name: Northern produce barrel
owners.description: One finite produce container. It is not a repeatable harvest source or a duplicate of merchant inventory.

owners.name: Southern produce barrel
owners.description: The second barrel has independent contents and state.
